title: Liquity-v1 fork with custom share-price oracles - live E-U $0; conditional liquidation bonus only
e_u_conditional_note: Fork PoC: after a 2% oracle decline, liquidating the closest yvcrvUSD trove repaid 38,962.20 USDC and returned collateral worth 40,699.24 USDC at the real price = +1,737.04 USDC. The trigger is a market/oracle move, not attacker-controlled; interest accrual alone is expected to cross 1.10 in ~9 days (m4), ~11 days (m2), ~34 days (m3), with a first-trigger bonus of ~$290-$560.
closed_reasons: No trove is below the 1.10 MCR; min CR = 1.10127 at block 26,217,683, so liquidate_trove reverts.
close_zombie_trove requires trove.owner or an approved operator; a random caller reverts (4 remaining zombies, $10,287.34 H-O).
TroveManager.redeem is onlyLender; external users cannot redeem.
Oracles are Yearn/ERC-4626 price-per-share or Curve-EMA feeds, not spot pools; donation raises pps by D/S and the borrow gain is 0.909*f*D < D, so inflation is unprofitable.
Market 1 (siUSD) is empty: 0 debt, 0 Lender assets; the iUSD=$1 assumption has no live pot.
No idle Lender liquidity at scale: m0 $2,002, m3 $22,775.92, m2/m4 $0, m5 0.009731 WETH.
All recent Dutch auctions are fully taken (current_amount = 0) and Auction collateral balances are 0.
key_facts: Zombie collateral still in TroveManagers: 1,521.88 + 488.67 + 486.02 yvUSD + 7,036.18 ysyBOLD = $10,287.34 at oracle prices; six other zombies (~$25,161) were claimed by owners between blocks 26,217,430 and 26,217,683.
Oracle marks: yvUSD $1.035049, siUSD $1.095252, ysyBOLD $1.094808 (depeg_mode=true), yvcrvUSD $1.160030, yvWETH 1.090920 WETH.
Market contracts are EIP-1167 minimal proxies with zero EIP-1967 impl/admin slots; the implementation cannot be swapped. Registry endorse/unendorse is only DADDY.
PoC at a 2% lower oracle: m4 liquidation repaid 38,962.199322 USDC, seized 35,085.025667 yvcrvUSD worth 40,699.237536 USDC at the real price, profit +1,737.038214 USDC (gas 1.9M).
PoC at the live price: liquidate_trove reverts; close_zombie_trove reverts for a random caller and succeeds for each owner; redeem reverts externally.

Auction.take has no nonReentrant modifier despite its comment; current_amount is updated before the callback but amount_received after it, so a receiver can reenter. All 31/36/12/8 auctions are fully taken and Auction collateral balances are 0, so live value is $0; only a price rise between kick and take could leak surplus.
caveats: Point-in-time snapshot; the zombie set is shrinking as owners claim collateral.
The 2% oracle-drop PoC is a mechanics proof, not a price forecast; the trigger (pps loss or crvUSD/BOLD depeg) is not attacker-controllable.
total_debt is not sync_total_debt()-refreshed; CRs use get_trove_debt_after_interest at the same block.
DefiLlama's $1.9M TVL counts gross collateral / a different WETH mark; Lender receivables are $1.665M.
The ysyBOLD depeg floor can be re-enabled by DADDY; if BOLD < 0.99 the floor would overvalue ysyBOLD (P-triggered, not live).
Auction.take reentrancy is a latent code-quality issue, not counted in E-U; no active auction at the snapshot.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Flex; the oracle/redemption code is closed because the oracles are NAV/pps or Curve-EMA feeds and no trove is below 1.10. Residual: $10,287.34 of owner-only zombie collateral and a $1,737 conditional liquidation bonus after a 2% oracle drop.
